verses.he: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ כִּי־ט֖וֹב זַמְּרָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ כִּֽי־נָ֝עִים נָאוָ֥ה תְהִלָּֽה׃
verses.en: Hallelujah; For it is good to sing praises unto our God; For it is pleasant, and praise is comely.

verses.he: בּוֹנֵ֣ה יְרוּשָׁלַ֣‍ִם יְהוָ֑ה נִדְחֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל יְכַנֵּֽס׃
verses.en: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem, He gathereth together the dispersed of Israel;

verses.he: הָ֭רֹפֵא לִשְׁב֣וּרֵי לֵ֑ב וּ֝מְחַבֵּ֗שׁ לְעַצְּבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.en: Who healeth the broken in heart, And bindeth up their wounds.

verses.he: מוֹנֶ֣ה מִ֭סְפָּר לַכּוֹכָבִ֑ים לְ֝כֻלָּ֗ם שֵׁמ֥וֹת יִקְרָֽא׃
verses.en: He counteth the number of the stars; He giveth them all their names.

verses.he: גָּד֣וֹל אֲדוֹנֵ֣ינוּ וְרַב־כֹּ֑חַ לִ֝תְבוּנָת֗וֹ אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.en: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding is infinite.

verses.he: מְעוֹדֵ֣ד עֲנָוִ֣ים יְהוָ֑ה מַשְׁפִּ֖יל רְשָׁעִ֣ים עֲדֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: The LORD upholdeth the humble; He bringeth the wicked down to the ground.

verses.he: עֱנ֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה בְּתוֹדָ֑ה זַמְּר֖וּ לֵאלֹהֵ֣ינוּ בְכִנּֽוֹר׃
verses.en: Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving, Sing praises upon the harp unto our God;

verses.he: הַֽמְכַסֶּ֬ה שָׁמַ֨יִם׀ בְּעָבִ֗ים הַמֵּכִ֣ין לָאָ֣רֶץ מָטָ֑ר הַמַּצְמִ֖יחַ הָרִ֣ים חָצִֽיר׃
verses.en: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, Who prepareth rain for the earth, Who maketh the mountains to spring with grass.

verses.he: נוֹתֵ֣ן לִבְהֵמָ֣ה לַחְמָ֑הּ לִבְנֵ֥י עֹ֝רֵ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִקְרָֽאוּ׃
verses.en: He giveth to the beast his food, And to the young ravens which cry.

verses.he: לֹ֤א בִגְבוּרַ֣ת הַסּ֣וּס יֶחְפָּ֑ץ לֹֽא־בְשׁוֹקֵ֖י הָאִ֣ישׁ יִרְצֶֽה׃
verses.en: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse; He taketh no pleasure in the legs of a man.

verses.he: רוֹצֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אֶת־יְרֵאָ֑יו אֶת־הַֽמְיַחֲלִ֥ים לְחַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear Him, In those that wait for His mercy.

verses.he: שַׁבְּחִ֣י יְ֭רוּשָׁלַ‍ִם אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה הַֽלְלִ֖י אֱלֹהַ֣יִךְ צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.en: Glorify the LORD, O Jerusalem; Praise thy God, O Zion.

verses.he: כִּֽי־חִ֭זַּק בְּרִיחֵ֣י שְׁעָרָ֑יִךְ בֵּרַ֖ךְ בָּנַ֣יִךְ בְּקִרְבֵּֽךְ׃
verses.en: For He hath made strong the bars of thy gates; He hath blessed thy children within thee.

verses.he: הַשָּׂם־גְּבוּלֵ֥ךְ שָׁל֑וֹם חֵ֥לֶב חִ֝טִּ֗ים יַשְׂבִּיעֵֽךְ׃
verses.en: He maketh thy borders peace; He giveth thee in plenty the fat of wheat.

verses.he: הַשֹּׁלֵ֣חַ אִמְרָת֣וֹ אָ֑רֶץ עַד־מְ֝הֵרָ֗ה יָר֥וּץ דְּבָרֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He sendeth out His commandment upon earth; His word runneth very swiftly.

verses.he: הַנֹּתֵ֣ן שֶׁ֣לֶג כַּצָּ֑מֶר כְּ֝פ֗וֹר כָּאֵ֥פֶר יְפַזֵּֽר׃
verses.en: He giveth snow like wool; He scattereth the hoar-frost like ashes.

verses.he: מַשְׁלִ֣יךְ קַֽרְח֣וֹ כְפִתִּ֑ים לִפְנֵ֥י קָ֝רָת֗וֹ מִ֣י יַעֲמֹֽד׃
verses.en: He casteth forth His ice like crumbs; Who can stand before His cold?

verses.he: יִשְׁלַ֣ח דְּבָר֣וֹ וְיַמְסֵ֑ם יַשֵּׁ֥ב ר֝וּח֗וֹ יִזְּלוּ־מָֽיִם׃
verses.en: He sendeth forth His word, and melteth them; He causeth His wind to blow, and the waters flow.

verses.he: מַגִּ֣יד דברו [דְּבָרָ֣יו] לְיַעֲקֹ֑ב חֻקָּ֥יו וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטָ֗יו לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.en: He declareth His word unto Jacob, His statutes and His ordinances unto Israel.

verses.he: לֹ֘א עָ֤שָׂה כֵ֨ן׀ לְכָל־גּ֗וֹי וּמִשְׁפָּטִ֥ים בַּל־יְדָע֗וּם הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃
verses.en: He hath not dealt so with any nation; And as for His ordinances, they have not known them. Hallelujah.
